title: Scope and bound salesman output approved-order evidence
description: Users open the existing salesman-output report and see only evidence for their authorized customers. Recheck identity and existing salesman-output menu; missing db/user/menu and unmapped user fail closed. Make resolved scope mandatory in GetSalesmanOutputAsync and update every caller/unit test, with no retained scope-free bypass. Only approved nondeleted assigned-salesman SalesOrders contribute; preserve existing omission of unassigned orders, explicitly label evidence as assigned approved orders rather than total ERP orders, production/revenue/shipment or receipts. Validate inclusive start/end dates up to 366 days before reads, end-day overflow explicitly invalid, end-next-day exclusive predicate. Apply current customer scope before stable 501-row header probe enforcing 500-order cap; legacy details if still needed are limited to 10001 rows for 10000 cap, related products/employees read in fixed scoped batches, no unauthorized employee names and no N+1. Overflow fails with no partial rows/aggregates. Legacy current-price profit and mixed-currency semantics are corrected in dependent ERP-236; do not expand this task to unrelated reports or dashboard layout. Development only: use the existing salesman-output menu, fresh current-user SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope and approved nondeleted SalesOrders; employee identity is an order attribute, never a broader permission boundary. Existing OperationLogMiddleware records HTTP audit; all endpoints recheck identity/menu/scope and reject invalid/revoked/source-overflow requests without data/file. No client identity/scope/rows/amounts as authority, expanded ERP permissions, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, business table writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL/real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible actions, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external database/browser acceptance is explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: HTTP requests resolve fresh identity/menu/customer scope and GetSalesmanOutputAsync requires scope; only approved nondeleted assigned-salesman orders from authorized customers contribute.

Inclusive date validation and scoped source caps precede aggregation; invalid/overflow requests fail closed, related identity reads remain bounded batches with stable results and no unauthorized names.
Report source labels identify assigned approved-order evidence; scope/status/deletion/date/cap regressions and existing service callers compile and configured safe Release build/test passes.
